bugs.title: Undefined variable 'color' in index.html inline script
bugs.description: Inline script 'Maktab hayotidan lavhalar' section used undefined 'color' variable instead of 'style.bg', causing ReferenceError and breaking the dynamic render.

bugs.title: search.js 'depth' variable out of scope in performSearch()
bugs.description: 'var depth' declared inside initSearch() (function scope) but used in performSearch() — undefined reference at runtime.

bugs.title: ES modules (type="module") blocked on file:// protocol
bugs.description: All scripts used type="module" with import/export syntax. Browsers block module scripts on file:// due to CORS — site completely broken when opened locally.
bugs.fix: Migrated all module scripts to regular <script defer> with window globals

bugs.title: search.js missing null guard for toggleBtn
bugs.description: initSearch() checked modal/input/results but NOT toggleBtn. Missing element would cause addEventListener crash.

bugs.title: search.js no null guard for closeBtn
bugs.description: closeBtn.addEventListener called without checking if closeBtn exists.

bugs.title: teacher-single.html missing element guards
bugs.description: getElementById calls could return null if element missing — no null checks, causes TypeError cascade.

bugs.title: news-single.html missing element guards
bugs.description: Same issue — direct getElementById calls without null verification.
bugs.fix: Added per-element null checks and try/catch

bugs.title: Breakpoint gap: CSS 992px vs Tailwind lg: 1024px (31px dead zone)
bugs.description: Custom CSS uses @media (max-width: 992px) but Tailwind's lg: breakpoint is 1024px. At 993-1023px, mobile nav shows but header height stays desktop-sized.
bugs.fix: Changed max-width: 992px → max-width: 1023px to match Tailwind breakpoint

bugs.title: scrolled: Tailwind variant is not registered — dead code
bugs.description: Header uses scrolled:h-[70px] scrolled:bg-white scrolled:shadow-lg, but 'scrolled:' is not a registered Tailwind variant. JIT ignores these classes. CSS fallback #main-header.scrolled already handles styling.
bugs.fix: Removed dead scrolled:* Tailwind classes (CSS handles scrolled state)

bugs.title: CTA button hidden on tablet (768-1023px)
bugs.description: Qabul 2026 button uses hidden lg:inline-block, so it disappears between 768-1023px (md range) with no alternative CTA visible.

bugs.title: Index page badge -right-10 causes horizontal overflow
bugs.description: Decorative 'Top Reyting' badge positioned at -right-10 extends 2.5rem beyond parent container, hidden only by body overflow-x:hidden band-aid.
bugs.fix: Changed -right-10 → right-0, added overflow-hidden to parent div

bugs.title: About page badge -left-10 + text-nowrap causes horizontal overflow
bugs.description: TOP-10 badge at -left-10 with text-nowrap text extends beyond viewport left edge on narrow screens.
bugs.fix: Changed -left-10 → left-0, removed text-nowrap, added overflow-hidden to parent

bugs.title: About page image rotate-2 + fixed h-[650px] causes overflow
bugs.description: Rotated image with fixed 650px height overflows on mobile (viewport < 650px) and rotation extends corners beyond container.
bugs.fix: Added responsive height (h-[300px] md:h-[450px] lg:h-[650px]), reduced rotate-2 → rotate-1, added overflow-hidden to parent

bugs.title: Teachers filter has redundant overflow-x-auto with flex-wrap
bugs.description: overflow-x-auto on flex-wrap container is unnecessary — buttons already wrap to next line.

bugs.title: Schedule swipe hint breakpoint mismatch
bugs.description: Swipe hint hidden at lg: (1024px) but table needs scrolling below 1000px — 24px gap where hint is hidden but scrolling needed.
bugs.fix: Changed lg:hidden → xl:hidden to match table's 1000px min-width
